name: Clockworker (Artificer Archetype)
body:
While a lot of artificers work with magic and technology, a clockworker focuses on clockwork technology and makes their own clockwork helper.

Clockwork Helper (Ex)

At 1st level, a clockworker forms a bond with one of their creations, and begins play with it at no cost. This functions as a familiar bond of a wizard, using the clockworker’s class level for their effective wizard level. If the clockworker would gain a familiar through another class, those levels stack for determining this familiar’s abilities. The familiar can take any shape the clockworker wishes, but its statistics are of a clockwork spy. The clockworker does not gain the familiar bonus for the form the clockwork spy takes, nor any bonus. The type of the clockwork spy stays construct (clockwork).

At 6th level, the clockwork spy changes into a clockwork familiar as if the clockworker possessed the Improved Familiar feat. The clockworker is treated as having the Improved Familiar feat for prerequisite purposes. This ability replaces scribe scroll and the bonus item creation feat gained at 6th level.

At 7th level, instead of speak with animals of its own kind, the clockwork spy gain speak to other constructs.

Tinkering (Ex)

Starting with 2nd level, in place of a bonus item creation or metamagic feat, the clockworker can spend 1 hour working on their clockwork spy/familiar to enhance it with one of the options from the following list:

DR 2/adamantine
Resist cold
Resist fire
+5 competence bonus on Stealth
Darkvision 120 ft.
+2 resistance bonus to Reflex save
+2 resistance bonus to Will save
+2 natural armor
Increase the fly maneuverability by 1 step
Increase the damage die of their attack by 1 step
DR 10/adamantine (req. DR 2/adamantine first.
A bonus feat for which they meet the prerequisite.
+10 competence bonus on Stealth (requires +5 competence bonus on Stealth first)

No option can be selected more than once. This ability modifies bonus item creation feat and bonus metamagic feat but does not prevent another archetype from replacing any of those bonus feats.
